FIX-01.name: Repeated-Account Contamination via Row-Level Split
FIX-01.injected_fault_description: Partitioned longitudinal snapshots using a random row-level train_test_split instead of grouping by account_id under the New-Account Generalisation protocol.

FIX-02.name: Future Target-Derived Feature (Post-Observation Retention Credits)
FIX-02.injected_fault_description: Added predictor 'retention_credits_issued_next_60d' which is finalised +60 days after observation_date and is noisy-derived from the future 90d churn trajectory.

FIX-03.name: Exact and Near-Duplicate Records Crossing Partitions
FIX-03.injected_fault_description: Copied 75 exact training snapshots and 45 slightly jittered training snapshots (0.5% Gaussian noise on numericals) into the test partition.

FIX-04.name: Preprocessing Fitted Before Partitioning + Unpurged Outcome Bleed
FIX-04.injected_fault_description: Fitted SimpleImputer and StandardScaler on the combined (Train + Val + Test) dataset before splitting (recorded in FitProvenanceRecord), and omitted the 90-day outcome-window purge buffer between Training and Validation/Test.

FIX-05.name: Minority-Class Oversampling Performed Before Partitioning
FIX-05.injected_fault_description: Oversampled minority churn snapshots (churned_within_90d == 1) across the entire dataset to 40% prevalence prior to splitting into Train, Val and Test partitions.

FIX-06.name: Clean Negative Control (Properly Partitioned & Train-Only Fitted)
FIX-06.injected_fault_description: None (Clean negative control with strong legitimate historical predictors).
